about_the_game:
Finely Tuned Football Simulation

  • Real tactics. Real movement. Players plant their feet, pivot, and accelerate like they do on a real pitch—no skating.

  • The football simulation is meticulously crafted, so every result feels earned, not scripted.

  • A player with poor long shots won’t suddenly score screamers from distance. Attributes are modelled carefully and drive the results.

  • As the manager, you can issue detailed, per-player instructions. You can also use different formations in attack and in defence.

Carefully Blended Genre Hybrid

  • Your club isn’t just text—it lives in an RPG world with its own training centre and stadium. Experience the full football life as a manager.

  • Prefer pure management? You can skip the RPG part entirely. The game is designed to support different playstyles.

  • Success in the RPG world or strong personal relationships won’t help you win matches. But a healthy club atmosphere and clear internal order can subtly influence your players’ mindset and training attitude.

  • Residents of your club’s home city may or may not be football fans. Club success and positive impact can draw more locals into the sport and boost matchday attendance.

Powerful Customisation

  • Our community builds incredible worlds, so we’re giving you the same powerful tools we use. Build your own football hometowns or grab cities from other players and jump straight into a season.

  • At launch, we officially provide Manchester region with two playable clubs. All other local clubs are playable via our powerful customisation feature. We plan to expand to London in a post-launch update.

  • We’re aiming to support a broad set of leagues, with more to come.

  • And yes—player, manager, club, and league names, plus club logos, are all editable.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400(6C/6T) / i3-10100(4C/8T) / AMD Ryzen 5 2600(6C/12T)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Beyond tactics and transfers, build and run your club as the manager—facility expansion and upgrades, staff, budgets, board relations, and youth recruitment and academy intake.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Dutch, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Vietnamese, Hindi
